target: Talkeven 1.1.0 for iOS and Android (language partners, plans, chat and private post meetup check-ins; no groups, no dating)

gates.name: Native typecheck, lint, domain and notification adapter tests
gates.evidence: npm run verify: typecheck, lint with zero warnings, 36 unit and 7 prototype tests (commit 6a0e27f). Rerun on the 1.1.0 tree (4bddd0d) before the production build.

gates.name: iOS and Android JavaScript bundle export
gates.evidence: npm run bundle:check, plus EAS iOS builds (latest: 13) and Android preview APKs built from the same tree.

gates.name: Native implementation of the v1 experience
gates.evidence: Discover, suggest a meetup (once or weekly), plans, chat, profile editing, block, report and delete account on the server callables (fad8c43 onward). 1.1.0 adds private post meetup check-ins (7088a70) and the Ocean Pool rebrand with a Community guidelines page (2aa01a2, 4bddd0d). Groups were removed in 1.0.1; dating is out of scope.

gates.name: Server authorization, database rules and adversarial emulator tests
gates.evidence: Default deny rules, 16+ callables plus answerCheckIn; 115 emulator tests pass. Staging (duodialect-staging, Sydney) deployed 30 Sep, check-ins verified live there 2 to 4 Oct. Production (duodialect) functions, rules and indexes, including the two check-in indexes, deployed 4 to 5 Oct; Cloud Scheduler enabled for the hourly sweepCheckIns, which runs clean.

gates.name: Real account lifecycle, invitations, acceptance and chat
gates.evidence: Staging, 2026-09-26: full flow verified in the web build, and on an iPhone 14 (TestFlight build 7) with invitations, acceptance, chat and notifications against demo partner accounts. Check-ins verified live on staging 2 to 4 Oct. Remaining: an Android device run.

gates.name: Age controls, deletion, reporting and moderation
gates.evidence: Implemented: adult only self declared birth date, deletion cascade, reports and moderation queue with audit log. talkeven.com checked live on 2026-10-05: privacy (names Lachlan Irving as operator), support (hello@talkeven.com, reply within two business days), community guidelines, delete account and child safety pages. hello@ forwarding verified end to end on 2026-10-07 (Cloudflare routing, MX and SPF, and a test email arrived).

gates.name: Installable signed iOS and Android builds meet current SDK requirements
gates.evidence: iOS done: build 11 (1.0.1, approved and live) and build 13 (1.0.1, commit 7088a70, TestFlight only). The 1.1.0 production build has not been run yet. Android: signed preview APK only; no AAB yet (must target API 36 or later).

gates.name: Recorded tests on real iPhone and Android devices
gates.evidence: iPhone 14, TestFlight builds 5 to 7 (2026-09-26): login, onboarding, staying signed in, plans, chat, message and plan notifications, and tapping a notification from a closed app opening the chat all confirmed by Lachlan. No Android device yet.

gates.name: TestFlight and Google Play closed test completed and defects resolved
gates.evidence: TestFlight internal group 'Team' exists; build 13 is in TestFlight. Google Play app creation is blocked on Android device verification in Play Console; the 12 tester, 14 day closed test applies (personal account created 2026-09-20).

gates.name: Accurate listing, policies, support, declarations and reviewer access
gates.evidence: 1.0.1 iOS listing complete and approved (text, URLs at talkeven.com, 5 screenshots, 18+ age rating, published privacy labels, free, all storefronts except the 27 EU regions, review account and notes). 1.1.0 entered in App Store Connect on 2026-10-07: new keywords and What's New (en-AU), an English (U.K.) localisation with its own keywords, 6 new screenshots on the 6.9 inch slot, and App Review notes for 1.1.0. The privacy label needed no change (Other User Content already covers check-in answers). Still pending: the Google Play listing.

gates.name: Final tested candidate approved for submission
gates.evidence: iOS 1.0 build 8 submitted 2026-09-26; App Review asked for information (Guideline 2.1). 1.0.1 build 11 resubmitted 2026-09-28 with a reply and screen recording, approved, and released on the App Store 2026-10-06 08:48 UTC. 1.1.0 has not been built or submitted yet. Google Play not submitted.
